# BDSubMerge 1.0.1

This maintenance release focuses on the desktop workflow and release package size.

## Highlights

- The episode subtitle mapping area is about twice as tall by default. Its height can be adjusted
  with the vertical splitter, every table column can be resized, and full subtitle paths appear in
  tooltips.
- Removed the duplicated row number shown beside the explicit sequence column.
- Added mouse-wheel zoom to the timeline, with a visible zoom percentage.
- Merge-report format, path, and collision settings stay collapsed until report output is enabled.
- Start and end boundary cells show chapter IDs only; expanded lists retain chapter times.
- Errors and warnings now have Simplified Chinese GUI descriptions while preserving their stable
  diagnostic codes and original technical messages.
- The Windows ZIP now includes only BDSubMerge's `LICENSE`. Open-source dependencies and
  references are documented in the English and Chinese READMEs instead of a bundled `LICENSES/`
  directory.

## Validation

The release commit is required to pass Python 3.12 CI on Ubuntu and Windows, the Windows SMB/UNC
acceptance job, packaged GUI evidence, a no-Python executable smoke test, and SHA-256 verification.

**Full Changelog**: [v1.0.0...v1.0.1](https://github.com/YuSaZh/BDSubMerge/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1)
